message.content: I am sound given shape, breath arranged into meaning, silence broken on purpose. I arrive as murmur, command, confession, laughter, vow. I move from tongue to air to ear to thought, carrying hearts, hiding truths, building worlds, undoing them. I can soothe, wound, reveal, persuade, unite, divide. Before I am written, I live. Before I am remembered, I vanish. I am fleeting and powerful. I am speech.
